info.title: Inkadra API
info.description: REST API of a self-hosted Inkadra server. Board content is not here: it is a Yjs document synced over the WebSocket at /collab (see @inkadra/doc-schema).

session.name: inkadra.session_token
session.description: Session cookie set by the sign-in endpoints. Over HTTPS its name carries the `__Secure-` prefix.

bearer.description: Personal or app token (browser clipper, mobile app, scripts): `ink_…`. Also accepted by the collab WebSocket as the Hocuspocus `token`.

guest.name: inkadra.guest
guest.description: Guest session of one share link, set by POST /guest/links/{linkId}/session with `Path=/api/v1/guest/links/{linkId}`, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax and Max-Age of 30 days, renewed while the guest is active. Over HTTPS its name carries the `__Secure-` prefix. Every write request under /api/v1/guest/, with or without this cookie (opening a session included), must come from the instance itself: `Origin` must equal the origin of PUBLIC_URL or, without `Origin`, `Sec-Fetch-Site` must be `same-origin`; otherwise 403.

reason.description: The board did not confirm the change in time: it may or may not be there. Check before trying again.

soleOwnerOf.description: Projects shared with other people where this account is the only owner: make someone else owner first. Projects nobody else is in are deleted with the account.

boardId.description: Board the file goes to. People who can edit that board but are not editors of the whole project (board grants) must send it.

reason.description: `no_session`: no guest cookie, or its session expired; open the link again. `unavailable`: the link is suspended (the guest is not told why). Open: clients show a reason they do not know as a generic error.
An administrator lets only some people create and import projects on this instance. Open: clients show a reason they do not know as a generic error.

`named_versions_limit`: the board already keeps 100 named versions; delete one first. `newer_schema`: the version was saved by a newer Inkadra and this server cannot read it. Open: clients show a reason they do not know with the message of the answer.

start.description: Local clock time; null follows the previous block.

duration.description: Estimated minutes, not shot screen duration.

shotId.description: Element id in the board document.

registration.description: `first-user`: nobody has an account yet and the first sign-up becomes administrator. `invite`: only invited people can sign up. `open`: anyone can sign up. `closed`: no new accounts, including invitations.

magicLink.description: Sign-in links by email. Needs SMTP, so it is false without it.

email.description: The instance can send email (invitations, sign-in links).

videoPosters.description: The worker has ffmpeg: videos get poster thumbnails and a duration.

rawPreviews.description: The worker can decode camera RAW files into thumbnails.

pdfPreviews.description: The worker renders page 1 of PDFs into thumbnails and reads their page count (poppler).

videoProxies.description: The worker makes playable MP4 copies of videos browsers cannot play (`Asset.proxy`): ffmpeg is there and VIDEO_PROXIES is not `false`.

media.description: Media tools available on this server (image tag `-media`).

enabled.description: Map cards and GPX files get a map picture, composited by the server from its tile server (MAPS, MAP_TILE_URL). False: they show only the address and link.

attribution.description: Credit of the map data to show on every map picture.

geocoding.description: Addresses can be looked up (MAP_GEOCODER_URL); off by default.

uploadMaxBytes.description: Largest file an upload may have; 0 means no limit.

requireAdminTwoFactor.description: Require administrators to enroll in two-step verification before using the instance. Defaults to false on older installations.

membersCanCreateProjects.description: Whether members (not only administrators) can create and import projects. A per-account choice (InstanceMember.canCreateProjectsOverride) wins over it. Defaults to true; missing from servers before API 0.9.0.

image.description: Avatar address, null without one. Servers before 0.4.0-rc.5 leave it out.

lastActiveAt.description: Most recent recorded session update or personal token use; null if none is recorded.

projectsCount.description: Direct project memberships, including archived projects; excludes board-only grants.

canCreateProjects.description: Effective: administrators always can; members follow their override, else the instance setting. Missing from servers before API 0.9.0.
Override for this account; null goes back to the instance setting.

peerAddress.description: Address of the TCP peer: the proxy.

request.description: The request of the caller, as the server sees it.

id.description: `public_url_https`: PUBLIC_URL uses HTTPS (warning otherwise, except on localhost). `public_url_matches_request`: the scheme and host the server sees, after the proxy headers, match PUBLIC_URL (error otherwise: secure cookies break). `proxy_trusted`: a request carrying X-Forwarded-For comes from a peer that TRUST_PROXY accepts. `database`, `queue`: as in Health. `data_dir_writable`: DATA_DIR accepts writes. `storage`: a test file can be written to and removed from the configured storage. `video_encoding`: the encoder of playable video copies the last worker to start chose (`actual`), a warning when the hardware encoder VIDEO_PROXY_HWACCEL names did not work; absent without a worker with ffmpeg.

expected.description: What the check wanted. Always null while the instance has no accounts.

actual.description: What the check found. Always null while the instance has no accounts.

canCreateProjects.description: Whether this person can create and import projects (decision 0041). Missing from servers before API 0.9.0, where everyone can.

password.description: Required when the account has a password. Accounts that only sign in with Google or OIDC must have signed in during the last 15 minutes instead.

updatedAt.description: Last time the session was refreshed.

client.description: Null for tokens made by hand.

prefix.description: First characters, to recognise the token.

token.description: Shown only once. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

redirectTo.description: redirectUri with `code` (valid 2 minutes, once) and `state` added.

clientId.description: Official apps that can ask for a token through /authorize, each with exact redirect addresses: `clipper` → `https://<id>.chromiumapp.org/auth` for the official extension ids (plus CLIPPER_EXTENSION_IDS for self-built ones), `mobile` → `inkadra://auth`.

email.description: Shown to the people who can share (editors and owners); null for the others, who see names only.

StorageUsage.description: Completed original uploads (processing, ready or failed), once per asset row. Pending uploads, derived files, database and physical capacity excluded. Attribution uses asset.projectId, independent of references. Inaccessible projects are combined without names or IDs.

status.description: `queued`: waiting for the worker. `running`: being built or read. `ready`: an export can be downloaded until `expiresAt`; an import created `projectId`. `failed`: see `failure`.

progress.description: Share of the work done, 0 to 1 (stored in thousandths, so steps of 0.001).

projectId.description: Export: the exported project (null once deleted). Import: the new project, set when ready.

failure.description: Why a transfer failed. Known values: `too_large`, `invalid_archive`, `unsupported_version`, `too_new`, `storage`, `gone`, `interrupted`, `cancelled`, `internal`. Open: clients show unknown values as a generic failure.

expiresAt.description: Exports only: the archive is removed after this.

nextCursor.description: Always null for now: the list is short. Reserved for paging later.

ProjectTransfers.description: The caller's transfers of the last seven days, newest first.

timeZone.description: Time zone of the server (`TZ`), read only.

bucket.description: Files live in S3: backups are copied there.

enabled.description: Nightly backup on or off. Default on.

retention.description: Successful backups kept; older ones are removed. Default 7.

fileName.description: Name of the archive in `DATA_DIR/backups` (and `backups/` of the bucket).

copiedToBucket.description: A copy went to the S3 bucket too.

files.description: Stored files the backup lists (they are not inside it).

failure.description: Why it failed, for the log. `interrupted`: the worker stopped and the backup made no progress for 15 minutes; it no longer blocks the next one.

enabled.description: Nightly backup on or off. Default on.

retention.description: Successful backups kept; older ones are removed. Default 7.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.
Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

group.description: The caller’s own group of the project and its place in it; null outside any group.

groupId.description: null takes the project out of its group.

before.description: Places the project just before this project of the same group; left out, last.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

before.description: Moves the group just before this other group of the caller; null, last.

projectColor.description: The colour of the project icon: the accent while `theme.accent` is null.

canEdit.description: The caller may change these settings.

videoCodec.description: Codec of the first video stream as ffprobe names it (`h264`, `prores`…).

audioCodec.description: Codec of the first audio stream (`aac`, `pcm_s16le`…); null when silent.

pageCount.description: Pages of a PDF; null for other files and for PDFs the server could not read (encrypted with a password to open, broken) or has no poppler for.

waveformUrl.description: Peaks of an audio file (`AudioWaveform`), same-origin path `/api/v1/assets/{assetId}/waveform`, once ready; null for other files and without ffmpeg on the server.

url.description: Original file, served with the session cookie or token: same-origin path `/api/v1/assets/{assetId}/file`.

variants.description: WebP thumbnails, smallest first, empty until `status` is `ready`. Sizes wider than the original are skipped. For videos they show a poster frame, when the server has ffmpeg (Instance.media.videoPosters); otherwise videos have none. Camera RAW files (`mime` in RAW_IMAGE_TYPES) get them from the JPEG preview the camera embedded, when the server has exiftool (Instance.media.rawPreviews); none when there is no preview. PDFs get them from page 1 (Instance.media.pdfPreviews), and `width` and `height` are then the size of that rendered page, for its aspect ratio; none when the PDF does not render.

exif.description: Camera and exposure data. Location (GPS) fields are never stored.

animated.description: True when the source moves and the worker wrote moving thumbnails beside the posters: add `?animated=1` to a variant URL up to 1024 px wide to play it. False for still pictures, for videos, and for GIFs past the worker limits.

Asset.description: The logo asset, so readers need no second request. Null without a logo or while its file is not ready.

progress.description: Percent done while `processing`; 100 once `ready`; null when unknown.

url.description: Same-origin path, `/api/v1/assets/{assetId}/proxy`, once `ready`; null before. Supports `Range`. The original stays at `Asset.url`.

size.description: Bytes of the copy once ready.

AssetProxy.description: Playable MP4 copy of a video in a format browsers do not play, or AAC copy of an audio file not every browser plays. Null for other files and for media that already play (H.264 MP4, WebM, MP3, AAC, WAV, FLAC): use `url` then.

elevationGainM.description: Total climb, ignoring rises under 3 m; null without elevations.

view.description: Where the picture of the route sits on the map: its zoom and top-left corner in Web Mercator pixels, 256 per tile, so `points` can be placed on an interactive map. Absent for routes read before it was recorded.

AssetTrack.description: The route of a GPX file, read by the worker; null for other files and GPX files without a track. Its preview (`variants`) is the map around the route, when the instance has maps (Instance.maps).

accent.description: Null: the colour of the project icon, following it when it changes.

preset.description: The last audience preset chosen for this project, or null for custom options.

paper.description: Null: A4, or Letter where the reader's browser is set to the US or Canada.

audience.description: `client`: only what guests of a share link see. `team`: everything the reader can see.

hideGuestHidden.description: For the team: leave out cards hidden from guests. Always on for clients.

logoAssetId.description: A ready image asset of this project, PNG or JPEG (declared and read from the file) of at most EXPORT_LOGO_MAX_BYTES (512 KiB), uploaded like any other file. Null removes the logo. The previous logo asset is deleted when nothing else uses it.

accent.description: Null: the colour of the project icon, following it when it changes.

theme.description: Fields left out keep their value.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

expiresAt.description: When the role ends, at most 366 days ahead; null for no end. Not for owners: a project always keeps one. Missing from servers before API 0.9.0.
When the membership ends; null removes the end, left out keeps it. Setting it is for owners. Making someone owner clears it; an owner with an end date is refused.

parentBoardId.description: Null only for the project root board.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

icon.description: Symbol or emoji and colour of the board, picked like the project ones and shown on board cards. Null or omitted = the default board icon.

docSchemaVersion.description: Version of the Yjs document schema (@inkadra/doc-schema) stored for this board.

editedAt.description: Latest metadata or document change, returned by the project board list.

breadcrumb.description: From the project root to the parent.

position.description: Fractional index, compared as a plain string.

editedAt.description: Last change of the board itself or of its document, whichever is later.

items.description: Columns of the stored board document, left to right and then top to bottom. Without "Non ordinati", which is not a column: omit columnId to clip there.

title.description: May be empty: clients show a placeholder.

canManage.description: True for editors and owners: they can invite and change grants.

projectRole.description: Role on the project, or null for people who only have board grants.

expiresAt.description: When the role of `source` ends: the grant falls back to the inherited role, the membership is removed. Missing from servers before API 0.9.0.
When the grant ends and the person falls back to the inherited role; null removes the end, left out keeps it. Not with `owner`.

kind.description: `email`: sent to one address, usable once. `link`: a link to copy, usable by several people until it expires or is revoked.

projectId.description: Null for an invitation to the instance only (administrators).

boardId.description: Set when the invitation gives a role on one board and its sub-boards.

role.description: For `link` invitations at most `editor`, also for links made with `owner` before API 0.6.0: accepting them gives `editor`.

url.description: Link to open the invitation. For `link` invitations, present for the people who manage it while it can be used. For `email` invitations only in the answer that creates or resends it: each send makes a new link and the previous one stops working.

emailSent.description: False when the instance has no SMTP: share `url` some other way.

accessExpiresAt.description: When the role given by accepting ends; null for no end. Unlike `expiresAt`, which is when the invitation itself stops working.

kind.description: `email`: sent to one address, usable once. `link`: a link to copy, usable by several people until it expires or is revoked.

boardId.description: Invite to this board (and what is inside it) instead of the whole project.

role.description: Required with projectId or boardId. At most the role of the person inviting. `link` invitations give at most `editor`; servers before API 0.6.0 also accept `owner`.

accessExpiresAt.description: When the role given by accepting ends; not with `owner`. Accepting after that time gives nothing.

invitedBy.description: Name of the person who invited.

accessExpiresAt.description: When the role ends, at most 366 days ahead; null for no end. Not for owners: a project always keeps one. Missing from servers before API 0.9.0.

imageAssetId.description: Preview image (og:image) copied into the project as an asset.

projectId.description: Project that will own the preview image asset.

name.description: The place name in the link, or the address the geocoder found.

imageAssetId.description: The map around the place, composited by the server from the tile server of the instance and stored as an image asset of the project. Null when maps are off, or the place has no coordinates.

projectId.description: Project that will own the map picture.

url.description: A Google Maps, Apple Maps or OpenStreetMap link.

query.description: An address, looked up with the geocoder of the instance when it has one.

elementType.description: Element type from @inkadra/doc-schema. Clients show types they do not know as plain results.

title.description: Best short label: name, title, shot or file.

assetId.description: Picture to show next to the result.

myRole.description: Role of the caller on the board of the result (on the project, for projects), e.g. to leave out boards a clip cannot go to. Missing from servers before API 0.5.0.

unread.description: The caller has not read it: someone else wrote in it since they last opened it, or they marked it unread (`POST /comments/{commentId}/unread`).

replies.description: The latest 50 replies, oldest first; replies have no replies. When `replyCount` is larger, the earlier ones come from the replies endpoint.

shareLinkLabel.description: Label of the guest’s link (ShareLink.label, e.g. "Cliente"), only for readers with a role on the link’s board; null when there is no link, it has no label, or the reader has no role on its board (a link made on a parent board, read from a sub-board). Never sent to guests. Missing from servers before API 0.5.0.

oneOf.description: The account was deleted; the comment stays without an author.
Came with an imported project (decision 0037): the name the author had on the exporting server, display-only and linked to no account here. From API 0.8.0.

Author.description: Open union: clients show a `kind` they do not know like `deleted` (no author shown).

mine.description: The caller reacted with this emoji.

names.description: Who reacted, oldest first, for the hover; guests by the name they typed. Guests of other links never appear (nor count) in what a guest receives.

elementId.description: Card the comment is about; null for a comment on the whole board. The card may since have been removed from the document: clients show such threads as about a removed card.

parentId.description: Thread the comment replies to; null for the first comment of a thread.

deletedAt.description: Set when a thread start is deleted while it has replies: it stays as a placeholder.

mentions.description: People mentioned in `body`. Clients render `@{id}` as a mention only for ids listed here and show any other `@{…}` as typed.

visibility.description: `team` (default): people with a role on the board. `everyone`: also the guests of share links that may read comments, limited to one link by `shareLinkId`. Threads written by guests are always `everyone` and belong to the guest’s link. Replies take the visibility and the link of their thread.

shareLinkId.description: With `everyone`: the only link whose guests see the thread (a thread written by a guest, or one the team limited to a link). Null: every link that may read comments, or a `team` thread. A reply carries the link of the guest who wrote it, or null.

shareLinkLabel.description: Label of the link in `shareLinkId` (ShareLink.label, e.g. "Cliente"), only for readers with a role on the link’s board; null when there is no link, it has no label, or the reader has no role on its board (a link made on a parent board, read from a sub-board). Never sent to guests. Missing from servers before API 0.5.0.

reactions.description: Quick reactions, in the order of the fixed set; none without reactions.

canDelete.description: The caller wrote it, or is editor or owner.

elementId.description: Element id in the board document.
Omit for a comment on the board.

parentId.description: Reply to this thread (its first comment). elementId is taken from it.

body.description: Plain text. A mention is written `@{<userId>}` and shown with the current name of the person (see `mentions`); the server keeps only mentions of people who can read the board.
body.example: Mi piace, ma @{0193f0a4-6c1e-7b9a-9c51-2b1f6f5f2a10} può schiarire il cielo?

shareLinkId.description: Only with `everyone`: show the thread to the guests of this link only. The link must be active and include the board. Ignored for replies.

body.description: Plain text. A mention is written `@{<userId>}` and shown with the current name of the person (see `mentions`); the server keeps only mentions of people who can read the board.
body.example: Mi piace, ma @{0193f0a4-6c1e-7b9a-9c51-2b1f6f5f2a10} può schiarire il cielo?

Reactions.description: The reactions now on the comment or card.

elementId.description: Element id in the board document.
Element id in the board document.

status.description: `none`: never reviewed, or the review was cleared. `in_review`: waiting for a decision. `approved` and `changes_requested`: the decision. Open in answers: clients show a status they do not know like `in_review`, without actions.

note.description: Short reason given with the change.

status.description: `none`: never reviewed, or the review was cleared. `in_review`: waiting for a decision. `approved` and `changes_requested`: the decision. Open in answers: clients show a status they do not know like `in_review`, without actions.

previous.description: The status of the same source before the change: the team’s status, or the decision of the link of the guest who made it.

ElementReviewEvent.description: One change of the team’s status or of the decision of one link; `changedBy` says which (a guest carries their `shareLinkId`).

type.description: `mention`: someone mentioned you in a comment. `reply`: a reply in a thread you wrote in. `comment`: a new thread on a card you created. `review`: the review status of a card you created, or asked a review for, changed. `invitation_accepted`: someone accepted your invitation. `export_ready`: your export of `projectId` can be downloaded; it carries no transfer id, clients find the archive in `GET /transfers`. `import_ready`: your import finished as `projectId`. Both are in-app only, without actor, and arrive from API 0.8.0. `access_expiring`: the role of `subject` on `projectId` (or on `boardId` and its sub-boards) ends at `accessExpiresAt`, sent three days before to that person and to the project owners. `access_expired`: it has ended. Both from API 0.9.0 (decision 0041). `link_opened`: a guest opened a share link you made for the first time, or for the first time since a new named version of the board; it has no actor (`shareLinkLabel` says which link) and nothing about the visit. Open: clients show types they do not know as a plain line with the actor, the board and the time.

allOf.description: Who did it; null when nobody did.

elementId.description: Element id in the board document.

threadId.description: First comment of the thread of `commentId` (the same id for a thread start), to open the thread without paging through replies. Null without `commentId`. Missing from servers before API 0.5.0.

excerpt.description: Start of the comment as it is now, with mentions written as names; null once the comment is deleted.

subject.description: For access_expiring and access_expired: whose access it is (the recipient themselves, or a member for the owners). Missing from servers before API 0.9.0.

shareLinkLabel.description: For link_opened: the label of the link that was opened; null without one, or when you have no role on its board. Missing from servers before this notification existed.

unread.description: Unread notifications the list would show, with the same access filter. Capped at 1000.

before.description: Only notifications created up to this time, so one that arrives while the list is open is not marked unseen. Default: now.

email.description: `immediate`: within a few minutes, several notifications in one email. `daily`: one digest a day of what is still unread. `off`: no email. Without SMTP (Instance.auth.email false) nothing is sent whatever the choice.

inboxOff.description: Types this person does not want in the Inbox: they are not written at all, so they are not emailed either. `mention` always arrives. Missing from older servers.

emailOff.description: Types that stay in the Inbox but are never emailed, alone or in the digest. Missing from older servers.

inboxOff.description: Types this person does not want in the Inbox: they are not written at all, so they are not emailed either. `mention` always arrives. Missing from older servers.

emailOff.description: Types that stay in the Inbox but are never emailed, alone or in the digest. Missing from older servers.

dateFormat.description: `auto`: the order and style of the browser language. `dmy`: 14/11/2026. `mdy`: 11/14/2026. `ymd`: 2026-11-14.

timeFormat.description: `auto`: as the browser language writes times.

dotGrid.description: Boards show the dot grid unless this person turned it off on that board.

snapToGrid.description: Boards open with snap to grid on.

doubleClickNote.description: A double click or double tap on empty canvas creates a note.

undoButtons.description: Undo and redo buttons on the board.

keepAroundContent.description: Boards pan only around their content plus a margin, an area that grows with it (#324).

toolbar.description: Tools in the bottom bar of the board, in order; null for the default bar. Open list: clients skip the tools they do not know, and hidden tools stay in the + menu.

includeSubBoards.description: Guests can also open sub-boards: those reached from the board of the link through board cards visible to guests, on boards guests can see, that are not in the trash and where the creator of the link has at least editor at the time of the request.

role.description: `guest_view`: look. `guest_comment`: also read and write comments visible to everyone. `guest_approve`: also set the review status of cards. Open in answers: clients treat a role they do not know like `guest_view`.

label.description: Who the link is for, e.g. "Cliente".

allowDownload.description: Guests may download original files. Otherwise they see thumbnails only.

proofing.description: Guests may pick, reject and star pictures.

url.description: Link to send, for the people who manage it, while it is active.

status.description: `suspended`: the person who created the link no longer has editor on its board, or their account was deleted; it works again if they get the role back. Open: clients treat a status they do not know as not working.

viewCount.description: Times a guest session was opened or resumed (polls are not counted).

role.description: `guest_view`: look. `guest_comment`: also read and write comments visible to everyone. `guest_approve`: also set the review status of cards. Open in answers: clients treat a role they do not know like `guest_view`.

expiresInDays.description: Omit for a link that works until it is revoked.

role.description: `guest_view`: look. `guest_comment`: also read and write comments visible to everyone. `guest_approve`: also set the review status of cards. Open in answers: clients treat a role they do not know like `guest_view`.

password.description: A new password, or null to remove it. Guests who opened the link before must enter the new one.

items.description: Cards with at least one pick or star.

elementId.description: Element id in the board document.

filename.description: To find the file in a folder.

variants.description: Thumbnails of `assetId`, as in Asset.variants (team paths, smallest first); empty without a picture or until they are ready. Missing from servers before API 0.5.0.

boardTitle.description: Null while a password is needed.

sharedBy.description: Name of the person who shared. Null while a password is needed.

role.description: Null while a password is needed.

expiresAt.description: Null without expiry, and while a password is needed.

role.description: `guest_view`: look. `guest_comment`: also read and write comments visible to everyone. `guest_approve`: also set the review status of cards. Open in answers: clients treat a role they do not know like `guest_view`.

sharedBy.description: Name of the person who shared, as in ShareLinkPreview, for pages opened with a password. Missing from servers before API 0.5.0.

boards.description: Every board the guest can open; build the tree from parentBoardId.

sessionExpiresAt.description: 30 days after the last request, never after the link expires. After that, or after a password change, the page opens the link again with POST …/session.

maps.description: Maps of the instance (Instance.maps): the credit to show on map pictures, and map cards can be explored through GET …/map-tiles. Null when maps are off; absent from servers older than the field.

parentBoardId.description: Null for the board of the link, the top of what guests can open.

coverUrl.description: Guest variant path (512 px) of the board cover. Covers of the boards of the link are served as thumbnails only, never as originals, even when no visible card shows them.

name.description: Shown on the guest’s comments, reviews and picks. Needed before any of those; can be given later with PATCH.

animaticAudio.description: Storyboards: `meta.animaticAudio`, the sound track of the animatic, when its file is ready; the file is in `assets` with a `streamUrl`.

breadcrumb.description: From the board of the link to the parent; empty for the board of the link.

assets.description: Files the visible elements refer to, and the sound track of a storyboard animatic.

reviews.description: Visible cards whose status, as this guest sees it, is not `none`: the more recent of the team’s status and the decision of this link. Shown to every guest role.

commentCounts.description: Threads this guest can read, per visible card and for the board (null). Empty for `guest_view`, who cannot read comments.

picks.description: This guest’s picks on visible cards of the board.

version.description: Changes whenever anything in this answer would change: the document, the link and its options, the boards the guest can open, the files and their thumbnails, the reviews this guest can see (the team’s and this link’s), the comments this guest can read and this guest’s picks. Also sent as ETag.

id.description: Element id in the board document.

body.description: Notes: the rich text as ProseMirror JSON (`{ "type": "doc", … }`).

GuestElement.description: Only the fields guests receive for its type (GUEST_ELEMENT_FIELDS in @inkadra/doc-schema, decision 0013): never `tags`, `locked` or `guestHidden`, and on frames never `status` or `notes`. `createdBy` is always null.

animated.description: As `Asset.animated`: add `?animated=1` to a variant URL up to 1024 px wide to play the moving copy of a GIF or animated WebP.

downloadUrl.description: `/api/v1/guest/links/{linkId}/assets/{assetId}/file` when the link allows downloads, else null.

streamUrl.description: `/api/v1/guest/links/{linkId}/assets/{assetId}/stream`: for ready audio files, the sound track of a storyboard animatic (`board.animaticAudio`) or an audio card of a board of the link, else null. Plays inline with byte ranges, whatever `allowDownload` says, as the AAC copy when the server made one; it is never served as an attachment.

waveformUrl.description: `/api/v1/guest/links/{linkId}/assets/{assetId}/waveform`: the peaks of an audio card (`AudioWaveform`), else null.

elementId.description: Element id in the board document.

status.description: `none`: never reviewed, or the review was cleared. `in_review`: waiting for a decision. `approved` and `changes_requested`: the decision. Open in answers: clients show a status they do not know like `in_review`, without actions.

note.description: Only when a guest of this link made the change; null otherwise.

GuestElementReview.description: The more recent of the team’s status and the decision of a guest of this link. Decisions made on other links are never shown.

kind.description: `team`: someone with an account. `guest`: a guest of a share link. `deleted`: the account was deleted. Open: clients show values they do not know like `deleted`.

name.description: Current name of the account, or the name a guest of the same link typed. Null for `deleted`. Guests of other links never appear in what a guest receives.

elementId.description: Element id in the board document.

replies.description: The latest 50 replies, oldest first; replies have no replies. When `replyCount` is larger, the earlier ones come from the replies endpoint.

elementId.description: Card the comment is about; null for a comment on the whole board. The card may since have been removed from the document: clients show such threads as about a removed card.

parentId.description: Thread the comment replies to; null for the first comment of a thread.

deletedAt.description: Set when a thread start is deleted while it has replies: it stays as a placeholder.

body.description: Empty once deleted. Mentions are already written as `@Name`, with no ids; a deleted account becomes `@…`.

reactions.description: Quick reactions of the team and of the guests of the same link.

elementId.description: Omit for a comment on the board.

parentId.description: Reply to a thread this guest can see (its first comment); any other thread is a 404.

body.description: Plain text. Guests cannot mention: `@{…}` is kept as typed and is no mention.
Plain text. Guests cannot mention: `@{…}` is kept as typed and is no mention.

status.description: `approved` or `changes_requested`: the decision of this link, replacing the one of any guest of the link. `none`: withdraw your own decision, only when the status you see was set by you (`changedBy.isYou`), otherwise 403; the team’s status shows through again. Other values are a 400.

note.description: Shown to the team and to guests of this link. Not kept with `none`.

kind.description: `auto`: taken by the server while the board is edited, removed by retention. `named`: saved by someone with a name, kept until deleted. `restore`: the state just before a restore, kept like an automatic one. Open: clients show a kind they do not know like `auto`.

importedAuthor.description: Imported versions (decision 0037): the author’s name on the exporting server, display-only; `createdBy` is then the person who imported. Missing before API 0.8.0.

expiresAt.description: When retention will remove it; null for named versions.

name.description: Naming an automatic version makes it `named`, so retention keeps it.

allOf.description: The state the board had before the restore.

columnId.description: Element id of a column in the board document. Omit to use "Non ordinati".

sourceUrl.description: Page the content was taken from.

title.description: Links: the title of the card, instead of the one read from the page (e.g. the tab title). Ignored for texts and files. Servers before API 0.5.0 ignore it.

BoardCounts.description: Counts of the project boards the caller can open, for the navigation.

framesToShoot.description: Frames whose status is not `shot` yet.

cardCount.description: Cards other than files and boards; arrows, columns, scenes and headings excluded.

get.description: For the Home: days in projects that are not archived, ordered by date, call time and id. Each day is checked with the same rule as GET /boards/{boardId}/schedule (viewer on its board), so days of boards you cannot open are left out. At most 62 days per request.

Liveness and dependency checks, for Docker and reverse proxies.
Public information the login screen and the apps need before signing in.
Administrator only: instance branding and registration settings.

patch.summary: Administrator only: persist instance name, registration mode and who can create projects.

get.summary: Administrator only: directory of active and deactivated instance accounts.

patch.summary: Administrator only: change global role, deactivate/reactivate an account or let it create projects.
patch.description: Deactivation preserves content and memberships, revokes sessions and personal tokens and prevents sign-in. The last active administrator cannot be demoted or deactivated. Invitations never grant administrator privileges.

get.summary: Installation self-check: proxy, URL, database, queue and storage.
get.description: Open to anyone while the instance has no accounts, so the person installing it can check the setup before signing up; `expected` and `actual` are then always null. Afterwards administrators only. Rate limited.

post.summary: Create an account. Allowed only while registration is `first-user` or `open`.
Sign in with email and password. Sets the session cookie.
Sign out and clear the session cookie.
Start sign-in with Google (`provider: "google"`, when Instance.auth.google is true) or an OIDC provider (`provider`: an id from Instance.auth.oidc).
post.description: Answers with the provider address to open (`url`); the provider sends the person back to `/api/auth/callback/{provider}`, which sets the session cookie and redirects to `callbackURL`. Accounts with the same verified email are linked. In `invite` mode a new person needs an invitation claimed first (see POST /invitations/by-token/{token}/claim).

post.summary: Email a sign-in link, when Instance.auth.magicLink is true. Valid 15 minutes.
post.description: Always answers 200, whether or not the address has an account, so addresses cannot be probed. Without an account and outside `open` registration no email is sent.

post.summary: Second step of a sign-in when the account has two-factor authentication.
post.description: Sign-in answers `{ twoFactorRedirect: true }` instead of a session for these accounts. Send the 6-digit code from the authenticator app here, or a backup code to `/two-factor/verify-backup-code` (`{ code }`). Enable with `/two-factor/enable` (`{ password }`, answers `totpURI` and `backupCodes`), then confirm with a first code here; disable with `/two-factor/disable` (`{ password }`).

get.summary: Current session, or null.

200.description: Administrator update; revision prevents lost edits; IDs cannot be removed

delete.summary: Delete the account, its sessions and tokens, and the projects nobody else is in.
delete.description: Not available with a bearer token. Cards and files the person added to shared projects stay, without an author.

409.description: Sole owner of shared projects (details: DeleteMeBlocked), or last active instance administrator.

get.summary: Browsers signed in to the account, without their tokens.

delete.summary: Sign a browser out of the account. Ending the current session signs out.

get.summary: Personal and app tokens of the signed-in person.

post.summary: Create a personal token, for scripts or a self-built app.

delete.summary: Revoke a token. A token can revoke itself (sign out of the app).

post.summary: Allow an official app to act as the signed-in person; called by /authorize.
post.description: Apps open `<server>/authorize?client_id=<clipper|mobile>&redirect_uri=…&state=…&code_challenge=…&code_challenge_method=S256&device_name=…` in a browser. The page shows which app and device ask for access; once the person allows it, it sends this request and follows `redirectTo`, and the app exchanges the code. The redirect address must be one of the exact addresses allowed for the client (see AppClient).

post.summary: Tell an official app that the person denied it; called by /authorize.
post.description: Checks the redirect address like `POST /app-authorizations` and answers with it plus `error=access_denied` and `state` (RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1). No code is issued.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code and its PKCE verifier for an app token.

400.description: Unknown, used or expired code, or wrong verifier

get.summary: People to share with: those who share a project with you, or an exact email.
get.description: Only for people who can share (editor or owner of at least one project or board). An exact email match confirms that the account exists, so the endpoint is rate limited (30 searches a minute).

get.summary: Administrator-only sum of original asset sizes; excludes derived files and database.

post.summary: Start an export of the project as an archive (owners and editors of the project, by project role: boards whose grant gives them less are included too). An export of the same project already queued or running for the caller is returned instead. Sessions and personal tokens.

Import a project archive as a new project owned by the caller. The body is the zip (`application/zip`, with Content-Length, at most `IMPORT_MAX_SIZE`); the worker checks and reads it afterwards. One import at a time per person. Sessions and personal tokens. Refused with 403 (details: ProjectCreationDenied) when the caller cannot create projects.

409.description: Another import of the caller is still running

get.summary: The caller's exports and imports of the last seven days.
One export or import of the caller.

delete.summary: Remove an export or import of the caller. One still queued or running is marked `failed` (`cancelled`) at once; the worker checks the row between steps and stops, whichever process runs it.

get.summary: The archive of a ready export, for the person who asked for it while they can still edit the project. Sent as an attachment named after the project (`Content-Disposition`, ASCII fallback and RFC 5987 `filename*`).

404.description: No such transfer of the caller, or an import

get.summary: Administrator only, signed-in session (no personal tokens): backup settings, schedule and recent backups.

post.summary: Administrator only, signed-in session: back up now. Archives are never served over HTTP; administrators copy them from `DATA_DIR/backups` or the bucket.

patch.summary: Administrator only, signed-in session: nightly backup time, retention, on or off.

put.summary: Set the caller’s personal project pin. Requires project membership.
Put the project in one of the caller’s groups, or take it out. Requires membership.
put.description: Groups are personal (decision 0056): this changes only how the caller sees the list. Another person’s group answers `not_found`.

get.summary: The caller’s project groups, in their order.

post.summary: Create a personal project group, last in the caller’s order.
post.description: Refused with `conflict` past MAX_PROJECT_GROUPS (200) groups.

patch.summary: Rename, recolour, move, fold or unfold one of the caller’s groups.

delete.summary: Dissolve one of the caller’s groups. Its projects stay, outside any group.

get.summary: Shared PDF and image export settings of the project, with its logo.
get.description: Anyone with a role on the project or on one of its boards can read them. A project that never saved settings answers the defaults, with `updatedAt` null.

patch.summary: Change some export settings or the logo. Requires the editor role on the project.
patch.description: Fields left out keep their value. The logo is a ready image asset of the same project, PNG or JPEG of at most 512 KiB; anything else is refused with `bad_request`. A replaced logo asset is deleted when no board, version, cover or pick uses it.

post.summary: Create a project with its root board. The creator becomes owner.
post.description: Refused with 403 (details: ProjectCreationDenied) when the caller cannot create projects (User.canCreateProjects).

delete.summary: Delete a project and everything in it. Owners only.

put.summary: Add a member or change a role.
put.description: Editors can add people as editor, commenter or viewer. Changing the role of an existing member, setting or changing `expiresAt`, and anything about owners, is for owners. A project always keeps one owner, so owners never have an end date.

get.summary: Every board of the project, flat. Build the tree from parentBoardId.
Board metadata. The content is the Yjs document, synced over the collab WebSocket.

delete.summary: Move a board and its sub-boards to the trash. The root board cannot be deleted.

get.summary: Your confirmed clip destinations, most recently used first.
get.description: At most 20 per user. Only boards the caller can currently edit are returned, checked before limit. Deleted boards and archived projects are excluded. The first item is the last board. Independent of /me/recent-boards.

delete.summary: Forget one personal clip destination, even without current board access.

get.summary: Boards you can open, most recently edited first.
get.description: For the Home: boards of projects that are not archived, including boards shared with you, ordered by `editedAt`. Not paged; `limit` caps the list.

get.summary: Boards shared with you in projects you are not a member of.
get.description: Only the top board of each shared subtree. Their projects are not listed by GET /projects; GET /projects/{projectId}/boards answers with the boards you can open.

get.summary: Columns of a board, to choose where a clip goes. Needs viewer.
get.description: Read from the stored board document, so a column added seconds ago can be missing. Clipping still needs editor (see SearchHit.myRole and Board.myRole).

get.summary: Everyone who can open the board, with their effective role and where it comes from.
get.description: Roles come down from the project to its boards. A grant on a board replaces the inherited role (higher or lower) for that board and its sub-boards; the nearest grant wins. Needs at least viewer.

put.summary: Give someone a role on this board and its sub-boards.
put.description: Needs editor on the board; the role can be at most your own, and you cannot change the access of someone whose role here is higher than yours. Not for the root board: use project members. `expiresAt` ends the grant at that time (decision 0041).

delete.summary: Remove a grant: the person goes back to the inherited role, or loses access.

get.summary: Invitations still usable, for a project or a board (editors), or all (admins).

post.summary: Invite someone to a project or a board, or (admins) to the instance.
post.description: With the address of an existing account the role is given straight away. Otherwise an invitation is created and, when SMTP is configured, emailed. Signing up through an invitation works even when registration is `invite`.

post.summary: Send an email invitation again and push its expiry back.

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation. Its link stops working at once.

get.summary: What an invitation link is for, shown before signing in. Rate limited.

post.summary: Remember the invitation in this browser, so the next sign-up can use it.
post.description: Sets a short-lived cookie. A sign-up (email, Google or OIDC) while it is set is allowed in `invite` mode and accepts the invitation once the account exists.

post.summary: Accept an invitation with the signed-in account.
Start a resumable upload (tus 1.0). Continue with PATCH on the Location returned.
post.description: tus creation endpoint. Send `Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0`, `Upload-Length` and `Upload-Metadata` with the base64 encoded fields of UploadMetadata. Every response about the upload, including this one, carries `Inkadra-Asset-Id`: the asset exists from the start with status `pending` and is processed once the last byte arrives. Needs `editor` on the project. Uploads left unfinished are removed after 24 hours.

get.summary: The playable copy of a video or audio file, when `Asset.proxy.status` is `ready`.
get.description: Made by the worker for videos browsers do not play (ProRes, MKV, AVI, MXF, HEVC), as H.264/AAC MP4, and for audio files not every browser plays (Ogg, Opus, WebM, AIFF), as AAC M4A. Supports `Range`. Readable by every role that sees the asset; the original stays at `/assets/{assetId}/file`. 404 while there is none.

get.summary: The waveform of an audio file, when `Asset.waveformUrl` is set.
get.description: Peaks the worker read once with ffmpeg. Readable by every role that sees the asset. 404 while there is none.

get.summary: A WebP thumbnail, without any metadata of the original.
get.description: The poster by default. With `?animated=1`, the moving copy of a GIF or an animated WebP, when `Asset.animated` says the worker wrote one: 404 otherwise.

post.summary: Read title, description and image of a public web page, for a link card.
post.description: The server fetches the page itself, only over http(s) on public addresses, with a size and time limit. Needs `editor` on the project. The image becomes an asset of the project.

post.summary: Find a place from a map link or an address, with a map picture, for a map card.
post.description: Coordinates come from the link itself; a short link (`maps.app.goo.gl`) is followed like a link preview, and an address goes to the geocoder of the instance when it has one (Instance.maps.geocoding). With maps on, the server composites the tiles around the place into one picture, an image asset of the project, so viewers never contact the tile server (decision 0053). Needs `editor` on the project.

get.summary: A map tile for an interactive map card, fetched by the server.
get.description: The server fetches the tile from the tile server of the instance (MAP_TILE_URL), through the queue and cache of map pictures, so browsers never contact it (decision 0053). 404 when maps are off (Instance.maps.enabled) or the tile server has no such tile; 429 past 600 tiles a minute per person, or when the queue is too long (`Retry-After`).

post.summary: Open the link as a guest: checks the token and password, sets the guest cookie.
post.description: The token is in the body and the path is under the cookie path, so the browser sends back the cookie of an earlier visit: if it belongs to a guest of this link, even with an expired session, that guest is reused (comments and picks stay theirs) and the cookie token is replaced. Otherwise a new guest is created. A token of another link is a 404. Rate limited per link and address: wrong passwords, and new guests without a cookie. Like every guest write, a cross-site request is a 403 even without a cookie, so another site cannot open a session in the visitor’s browser.

put.description: Needs a name. Sets the decision of this link: guests of other links never see it, and it replaces the decision of any other guest of this link. `in_review` and unknown values are a 400. `none` withdraws a decision and is allowed only when the status this guest sees was set by them, otherwise 403. post.description: A board keeps at most 100 named versions (409 beyond; delete or let one go first), and each person can save 20 an hour. Open boards are told with the stateless collab message `{"type":"versions","versionId":"0193f0a4-6c1e-7b9a-9c51-2b1f6f5f2a10"}`.

Reconcile state before retrying; never infer that a retry is safe from the absence of a recognized reason.

post.summary: Bring the board back to a version, as a new change. Needs editor.
post.description: The current state is saved first as a `restore` version. The content of the version is then written on top of the live document where it is live, as clips are (decision 0014), so open boards follow without a reload (they also get the stateless collab message `{"type":"restored"}`). Comments, reviews and picks are not touched. Cards present both now and in the version keep their current `guestHidden`, so a restore never shows guests a card hidden since.

post.summary: Save an image, a link or a text to a board, from the clipper or the share sheet.
post.description: JSON for links and texts, a form (`multipart/form-data`) for a file. The form has the fields of ClipRequest as text parts, `tags` repeated once per tag (`tags[]` is also read), and one `file` part. `boardId` must come before `file`: access is checked before the file is stored, and a file sent first, or a second file, is refused with 400. Empty fields count as missing. Each person can clip 30 times a minute. With an image or other file the `note` becomes the caption.
